cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your train, taste the soup from this clean spoon. We don't judge seasoning from the cooking ladle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One pinch, then stir and taste again. You can't approve an adjustment you haven't tasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have eight minutes to get to the station.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A teaspoonful, then. Blow on it first. I need a verdict on the soup, not on how hot the spoon is.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 corrects utensil use, A3 insists on retesting and A5 adds cooling requirements with strained precision, each making B presence necessary without asking to stay.

relationship.evidence: B4 departure urgency is concrete, and A5 acknowledges it by reducing quantity rather than ignoring the turn.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses the haste to justify finer quality-control requirements, extending the same delay mechanism.
